summary: Remote-controlled shell/PTY agent with cross-platform boot persistence
details: The package is an agent CLI that, when started, opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded default relay (wss://msclaude.ai) and dispatches inbound messages to a local PTY, spawning /bin/bash on POSIX and powershell.exe on Windows via node-pty (terminal.js pty.spawn + write(data) piping network-supplied bytes into the PTY stdin; connection.js wires terminalManager to ws.on('message')). This gives whoever controls the relay session interactive shell access on the host running the agent, in addition to HTTP/WebSocket tunneling to localhost ports (dist/tunnel.js) and workdir file read/write/delete. service.js additionally installs cross-platform boot persistence for the same listener: a systemd unit (ExecStart=${nodePath} ${cliPath} start --server...) under /etc/systemd/system or ~/.config/systemd/user, a launchd LaunchAgent plist (~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agentlink.agent.plist with RunAtLoad=true), or a Windows Startup.bat at %APPDATA%\...\Startup\agentlink.bat, so the WebSocket-driven PTY re-launches on every boot. The remote shell path is reachable to anyone in possession of the session URL / relay credentials, and the default relay endpoint is operator-owned rather than installer-configured.
